project.title: Backend Interview Preparation
project.description: Explore backend mechanisms and tradeoffs to build a structured personal textbook.

goal.content: Prepare for backend interviews by explaining core mechanisms, analyzing tradeoffs, and turning discussions into a personal textbook.

plan.overview: Start with concrete database questions, then connect them to caching and concurrency. Adjust the order as the discussion develops.

nodes.title: MySQL
nodes.description: Explore database mechanisms through data access and concurrency questions.

children.title: Indexes and Queries
children.description: Use query examples to discuss how indexes affect data access.

children.title: Transactions and Isolation
children.description: Use concurrent reads and writes to discuss isolation and its implementation.

nodes.title: Redis
nodes.description: Discuss caching through concrete use cases.

children.title: Cache Consistency
children.description: Discuss problems that can arise when updating caches and databases.

textbook.title: My Backend Notes
textbook.subtitle: Explanations and connections built from concrete questions

chapters.title: Databases
chapters.purpose: Organize material that has been discussed and approved for inclusion.

paragraphs.text: When discussing indexes, first identify the data a query needs, then compare access methods.

activities.description: Established the goal of explaining backend mechanisms and tradeoffs.
Selected transactions and isolation as the current exploration topic.
Added the discussed explanation of indexes to the textbook.
